hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Aisha: The most hated of men to the Messenger of Allah was the one who is fierce in disputation.

narrators.name: ابن جريج
narrators.full_name: عبد الملك بن عبد العزيز بن جريج المكي
reliabilityIssues: mudallis - Category 3 according to Ibn Hajar, requires explicit hearing terms

narrators.name: ابن أبي مليكة
narrators.full_name: عبد الله بن عبيد الله بن أبي مليكة

chainIssues: Ibn Jurayj is a known mudallis (Category 3) and uses 'an (عَنْ)
Multiple uses of 'an throughout the chain
Ibn Abi Mulaykah's hearing from Aisha needs verification given the 'an usage

plainChains: معمر -> ابن جريج -> ابن أبي مليكة -> عائشة -> النبي ﷺ

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Jurayj (ابن جريج) is classified as a mudallis (Category 3 per Ibn Hajar) and uses the ambiguous term 'an (عَنْ)
potential_issues.impact: Ibn Jurayj's tadlis is significant (Category 3), and he requires explicit hearing terms for full acceptance. His use of 'an here creates uncertainty about whether he heard directly from Ibn Abi Mulaykah. Despite his being Thiqah, this tadlis with 'an affects reliability.

potential_issues.issue: Multiple uses of 'an (عَنْ) throughout the chain
potential_issues.impact: The accumulation of 'an usage, especially from a known mudallis like Ibn Jurayj, reduces confidence in the chain's continuity.

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Abi Mulaykah's connection to Aisha also uses 'an
potential_issues.impact: While Ibn Abi Mulaykah is Thiqah and not known for tadlis, the combined effect of multiple 'an terms in the chain creates cumulative ambiguity.

Topics: Character traits disliked by the Prophet ﷺ
hadiths.arabicText: أرنا /94 مَعْمَرٌ /94 , عَنِ /26 ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ /26 , عَنِ /26 ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ /26 , /27 عَنْ /93 عَائِشَةَ L4049 /93 , قَالَتْ : /20 " كَانَ أَبْغَضَ الرِّجَالِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ، الأَلَدُّ الْخَصِمُ " /27 *

hadiths.english_translation: Masruq said: Khabbab ibn al-Aratt said: 'I was a young man, and I used to work for al-'As ibn Wa'il. Money was owed to me by him, so I came to collect my debt.' He said: 'I will not pay you until you disbelieve in Muhammad.' I said: 'I will not disbelieve in Muhammad until you die and then are resurrected.' He said: 'If I am resurrected, I will have wealth and children.' He said: 'So I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ,' and Allah the Exalted revealed: 'Have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, I will surely be given wealth and children?' [Quran 19:77] up to His saying: 'And will come to Us alone' [Quran 19:80].

narrators.name: الأعمش
reliabilityIssues: mudallis - Category 2, generally acceptable even with 'an

chainIssues: Al-A'mash is a mudallis (Category 2) and uses 'an (عَنْ)
Multiple uses of 'an throughout the chain
However, Al-A'mash's Category 2 tadlis is generally acceptable even with 'an

plainChains: الثوري -> الأعمش -> أبو الضحى -> مسروق -> خباب بن الأرت -> النبي ﷺ

potential_issues.issue: Al-A'mash (الأعمش) is classified as a mudallis (Category 2 per Ibn Hajar) and uses 'an (عَنْ)
potential_issues.impact: Al-A'mash's tadlis is Category 2, which means it is generally acceptable even when he uses 'an. Category 2 mudallisun are those whose tadlis is minimal and does not significantly affect acceptance. Therefore, this does not substantially weaken the hadith.

potential_issues.issue: Multiple uses of 'an (عَنْ) in the chain
potential_issues.impact: While 'an is used multiple times, all narrators are reliable (Thiqah or better) and none besides Al-A'mash is known for problematic tadlis. The cumulative effect is minimal given their reliability.

potential_issues.issue: The narration includes both historical dialogue and mention of revelation, creating a complex narrative structure
potential_issues.impact: This is a well-known incident documented in the books of tafsir. The chain is strong with all reliable narrators. The complexity of the narrative does not affect the chain's integrity.

Topics: Incident of Khabbab ibn al-Aratt seeking payment from al-'As ibn Wa'il
Al-'As ibn Wa'il's arrogant claim about resurrection
Context of revelation for Surah Maryam verses 77-80
Story of early Muslim persecution in Makkah
Steadfastness of Khabbab in faith despite economic pressure
Quranic response to disbelievers' claims about afterlife
hadiths.arabicText: /40 أرنا /94 الثَّوْرِيُّ L3436 /94 , عَنِ /26 الأَعْمَشِ L3629 /26 , عَنْ /26 أَبِي الضُّحَى L7469 /26 ، عَنْ /26 مَسْرُوقٍ L7430 /26 , قَالَ : /27 قَالَ /93 خَبَّابُ بْنُ الأَرَتِّ L2698 /93 : /20 " كُنْتُ فَتِيًّا ، وَكُنْتُ أَعْمَلُ لِلْعَاصِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ , فَاجْتَمَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ دَرَاهِمُ فَجِئْتُ لأَتَقَاضَاهُ " , فَقَالَ : لا أَقْضِيكَ حَتَّى تَكْفُرَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ : قُلْتُ : " لا أَكْفُرُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى تَمُوتَ , ثُمَّ تُبْعَثَ " , قَالَ : فَإِذَا بُعِثْتُ كَانَ لِي مَالٌ وَوَلَدٌ , قَالَ : " فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : /4 أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لأُوتَيَنَّ مَالا سورة مريم آية 77 /4 إِلَى قَوْلِهِ : /4 وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا سورة مريم آية 80 /4 /27 *
